## Mini project — Clinvar cclustered pairs: extraction and stats

```Python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

"""----- 1 Load one file -----"""
csv_path = Path("clinvar_clustered_pairs_1000bp.csv")
DTYPES = {
    "chrom": "string", "pos1": "Int64", "pos2": "Int64",
    "distance_bp": "Int64", "rs1": "string", "rs2": "string",
    "genes1": "string", "genes2": "string", "shared_genes": "string",
}
df = pd.read_csv(csv_path, dtype=DTYPES, low_memory=False)

# If distance not present or has NAs, recompute from pos1/pos2
if "distance_bp" not in df or df["distance_bp"].isna().any():
    df["distance_bp"] = (df[["pos1","pos2"]].max(axis=1) - df[["pos1","pos2"]].min(axis=1)).astype("Int64")

""" ----- 2 Simple stats -----"""
dist = df["distance_bp"].dropna().astype(int)
same_gene_frac = (df["shared_genes"].fillna("") != "").mean()

summary = {
    "run_time": datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
    "file": csv_path.name,
    "n_pairs": int(len(df)),
    "same_gene_fraction": round(float(same_gene_frac), 4),
    "dist_min": int(dist.min()) if len(dist) else None,
    "dist_median": float(np.median(dist)) if len(dist) else None,
    "dist_mean": round(float(dist.mean()), 2) if len(dist) else None,
    "dist_p95": float(np.percentile(dist, 95)) if len(dist) else None,
}
# tightness thresholds
for thr in (10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000):
    summary[f"frac_≤{thr}bp"] = round(float((dist <= thr).mean()), 4) if len(dist) else None

print(summary)

""" ----- 3 Log the stats to a persistent CSV -----"""
log_path = Path("cluster_metrics_log.csv")
log_df = pd.DataFrame([summary])
if log_path.exists():
    log_df.to_csv(log_path, mode="a", header=False, index=False)
else:
    log_df.to_csv(log_path, index=False)
print(f"Appended metrics to {log_path}")

""" ----- 4 Tiny extra artifacts -----"""
# Top chromosomes
top_chroms = df["chrom"].value_counts().head(10)
top_chroms.to_csv("top_chroms.csv")

# Top genes by appearance (genes1 + genes2)
def split_genes(series):
    genes = []
    for s in series.fillna(""):
        genes.extend([g for g in str(s).split(";") if g])
    return genes

top_genes = (
    pd.Series(split_genes(df["genes1"]) + split_genes(df["genes2"]))
      .value_counts()
      .head(20)
)

# Linear (zoomed to ≤500 bp so you see the peak)
plt.hist(dist[dist <= 500], bins=50)
plt.xlabel("Clustered pair distance (bp) — zoom ≤ 500")
plt.ylabel("Count")
plt.title("Cluster tightness (zoom)")
plt.show()

top_genes.to_csv("top_genes.csv")
print("Wrote top_chroms.csv and top_genes.csv")
```
